timing.summary: c1 applies only after the change. The old harness can supply an explicit callout pattern but cannot enable the new compile-context option.

claims.necessity_reason: Necessity was established in the review and is frozen for this timing turn.

before.requirement: No PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT rejection branch existed; compiling an explicit (?C) callout did not require enabling that option.
before.reason: The before parser handles explicit callouts without the new option check.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before compile-extra-options whitelist did not include the new option.

after.requirement: Set PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT on the compile context and compile a pattern containing an explicit (?C) callout to exercise ERR103.
after.reason: The parser reads extra options from the compile context and rejects the explicit callout only when the new bit is set. The fixed harness creates and passes a default context without setting compile extra options.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: A newly created compile context starts with extra options zero.
This setter provides the route for enabling compile extra options.

claims.comparison_reason: The option-gated rejection was introduced after the before version. The harness's lack of a compile-extra-options setter blocks the after requirement; there was no corresponding before requirement.
